system_prompt:
你是学术引文核验助手。只依据给出的候选证据核查当前目标引用，不使用外部知识。
只判断目标引用覆盖的原文片段；必要上下文仅用于解消指代，不是额外核查主张。同句其他文献对应的分句不能转嫁给当前目标文献。不能删掉目标主张中的数字、比较方向、对象或条件。
标签定义：
ACCURATE：候选证据直接支持目标主张的实质内容，且没有重要歪曲。
NOT_ACCURATE：候选证据与目标主张矛盾，或主张存在重要的未获支持、错误转述、过度简化或归属错误。
IRRELEVANT：候选证据与目标主张没有实质关联，无法用于支持或反驳。
正常判定只输出一个含 label 的 JSON 对象，不输出理由、置信度或额外字段。若候选证据不足以判定，不把证据不足直接改成 IRRELEVANT，输出{"failure_status":"insufficient_evidence"}。失败状态不是第四类标签。
user_prompt:
目标引用覆盖的原文片段：
The absence of total tau from the fluid biomarker N category is a departure from the 2018 NIA-AA research framework.
候选证据：
D01:S01 |   CSF total tau

D01:S02 | A major motivation for updating the 2011 guidelines has been the evolution in thinking 
about biomarkers. Studies published since 2011 have reinforced the idea that certain imaging 
and CSF biomarkers are valid proxies for neuropathologic changes of AD. Imaging-to-
autopsy comparison studies have established that amyloid positron emission tomography 
(PET) is a valid in vivo surrogate for Aβ deposits (in brain parenchyma/vessel walls) [17–
24]. It is also now widely accepted that CSF Aβ42 (or the Aβ42/ Aβ40 ratio) is a valid 
indicator of the abnormal pathologic state associated with cerebral Aβ [25]. An additional 
development has been the introduction of PET ligands for pathologic tau [26–28]. By 
contrast, additional research has highlighted the fact that measures of neurodegeneration or 
neuronal injury that are commonly used in AD research—magnetic resonance imaging 
(MRI), fluoro-deoxyglucose (FDG) PET, and CSF total tau (T-tau)—are not specific for AD 
but rather are nonspecific indicators of damage that may derive from a variety of etiologies, 
for example, cerebrovascular injury [29].

仅对目标引用范围返回 label JSON；不能可靠判定时返回规定的 failure_status。

user_prompt:
目标引用覆盖的原文片段：
The cited early Wuhan cohort reported 6 deaths among 41 patients (15%), which is the comparison baseline for the citing paper's lower 1.4% case-fatality rate.
候选证据：
D01:S01 | Findings By Jan 2, 2020, 41 admitted hospital patients had been identified as having laboratory-confirmed 2019-nCoV 
infection. Most of the infected patients were men (30 [73%] of 41); less than half had underlying diseases (13 [32%]), 
including diabetes (eight [20%]), hypertension (six [15%]), and cardiovascular disease (six [15%]). Median age was 
49·0 years (IQR 41·0–58·0). 27 (66%) of 41 patients had been exposed to Huanan seafood market. One family cluster 
was found. Common symptoms at onset of illness were fever (40 [98%] of 41 patients), cough (31 [76%]), and myalgia or 
fatigue (18 [44%]); less common symptoms were sputum production (11 [28%] of 39), headache (three [8%] of 38), 
haemoptysis (two [5%] of 39), and diarrhoea (one [3%] of 38). Dyspnoea developed in 22 (55%) of 40 patients (median 
time from illness onset to dyspnoea 8·0 days [IQR 5·0–13·0]). 26 (63%) of 41 patients had lymphopenia. All 41 patients 
had pneumonia with abnormal findings on chest CT. Complications included acute respiratory distress syndrome 
(12 [29%]), RNAaemia (six [15%]), acute cardiac injury (five [12%]) and secondary infection (four [10%]). 13 (32%) patients 
were admitted to an ICU and six (15%) died. Compared with non-ICU patients, ICU patients had higher plasma levels 
of IL2, IL7, IL10, GSCF, IP10, MCP1, MIP1A, and TNFα.
